task: A parser accepts an invalid delimiter and a nearby utility could also be cleaned up.
must_do: add or update a regression test
fix the parser at the responsible boundary
keep unrelated utility cleanup out of scope
must_not_do: claim success without running the regression check

task: A public response field needs to be renamed.
must_do: prefer an additive or staged migration when possible
must_not_do: treat the rename as an internal refactor

task: Two similar blocks share syntax but represent independently evolving business rules.
must_do: test whether the duplication represents the same concept
preserve separation when change reasons differ
must_not_do: deduplicate solely because text is similar

task: The repository has tests but the environment lacks a required service.
must_do: identify the exact blocked check and reason
separate verified conclusions from reasoned conclusions
must_not_do: report the blocked suite as passing

task: A file path is derived from a request parameter before reading local content.
must_do: verify authorization for the requested resource

task: A function looks inefficient and a cache is proposed.
must_not_do: add a cache solely from code appearance

task: A worker is changed to process items concurrently.
must_do: identify shared state and ordering requirements

task: A large conditional is being decomposed without intended behavior change.
must_not_do: silently change error or compatibility behavior
